subject: Marketplace evidence handoff & listing orchestration
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aws-partners.amazon.com>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding for Acme Health - evidence & timeline

Sophie / Marketplace Ops team,

Thanks again for the quick slot on Friday. Per our call, Acme Health (prospect) is prioritizing an early-June listing and co-sell kick-off. To keep things tight on both sides we want to hand over a compact evidence bundle and an owner for each gating item.

Request: can you confirm the exact evidence artifacts your ops team needs to accept a public listing (e.g., SAML config, SOC2 attestation PDF, usage/meters screenshot, billing SKU mapping)? We generally have the artifacts but want to avoid back-and-forth.

I'll attach the draft evidence binder and a short SAML diagram. Ben will own metering screenshots and Marissa will coordinate the co-sell enablement doc.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the gating checklist (timeline: 48h)
- We deliver finalized artifacts + test account by Tue 5/11
- Marketplace team schedules listing review and set a target publish date (we'd like 6/7 if feasible)

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_evidence_v1.pdf (summary binder), saml_integration_diagram.png

From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aws-partners.amazon.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding for Acme Health - evidence & timeline

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the binder — looks like a good starting point. High-level list from our side for a public listing + co-sell enablement:

1) Legal/commercial: signed Marketplace Partner Agreement (we already have the countersigned copy on file for Redwood).
2) Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II report or letter of attestation (PDF).
3) Technical: SAML SSO diagram + metadata, proof-of-concept/test account credentials (read-only), and a sample API call showing token-based usage.
4) Metering: screenshot of the billing/metering dashboard and a mapping doc that ties product SKUs to marketplace entitlements.
5) Listing assets: 1-2 screenshots, product description, pricing table (per-hour + subscription).
6) Co-sell plan: named contacts, GTM assets, and a short mutual action plan.

If you can provide the items above by Tue 5/11, we can slot you for the partner listing review next Wed (5/12) and aim for publish the following week. Also please include a HubSpot deal link and a point of contact for technical triage during review.

I'll loop in the listing intake specialist if/when we have the final artifacts.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Marketplace Partnerships - AWS
aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding for Acme Health - evidence & timeline

Team — quick ops plan on what I'm taking:

- I will export the billing/metering screenshots and do a short SKU mapping doc (deliverable: trial_metrics_snapshot.csv + sku_mapping.md).
- Olga, please validate the SAML diagram and provide the metadata XML for their test tenant. I put the current image in the binder but we need the metadata file for their ops console.
- Marissa, can you draft the 1-page co-sell checklist / named contacts? We should include our inbound SDR for Acme and the AE.

Attachments I'll provide: trial_metrics_snapshot.csv (fake but representative metrics), redwood_marketplace_evidence_v1.pdf (updated with metrics), and a small readme. Will upload to the Drive link and share access with sophie.

Ben
Channel & Partnerships, Redwood Inference

On Wed, May 6, 2026 at 09:30 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding for Acme Health - evidence & timeline

Sophie — attaching the updated evidence bundle per Ben/Olga/Marissa's inputs.

What we attached:
- redwood_marketplace_evidence_v1.pdf (now includes meter snapshots and SKU mapping notes)
- saml_integration_diagram.png (finalized, note included on metadata endpoint)
- trial_metrics_snapshot.csv (sample metrics and test tenant ID)

Quick notes:
- Test tenant credentials: redwood-acme-test (read-only) — shared in the Drive link.
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2026-MP-78
- Publish target: Redwood requests 2026-06-07; if ops needs more time we'll accept alternate dates but would like to lock a week.

Can you confirm the intake specialist and whether we should open a case in the marketplace portal prior to the review? If helpful, Ben and Olga can join the review meeting.

Thanks,
Mateo

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_evidence_v1.pdf, saml_integration_diagram.png, trial_metrics_snapshot.csv

Thanks Mateo — received the binder and artifacts. Intake specialist is Priya R. (cc'd below in the console). Priya will open the formal intake ticket; you should get an automated email with intake ID within 24 hours.

Next steps from AWS ops:
- Priya opens intake and schedules a short technical review (we've penciled Wed 5/12 10:00 AM PT, pending Priya's confirmation).
